testcase.name: Scenario: Open an Annotate command panel on the floating ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:294:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open an Annotate command panel on the floating ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active and the ribbon is floating with 3D Model selected ✔ When the user selects Annotate ✔ Then the ribbon displays its annotation groups ✔ When the user selects Notes ✔ Then the adjacent panel lists Leader Text, General Note and General Profile Note ✔ When the user selects 3D Model ✔ Then the Notes panel closes ✔ And the modeling groups return ✔ And the part remains active
